subject: 1,000,000 queries solved (and 7 AI models to compare)
preheader: AI Chef Pro agents have already handled over a million queries. Here's what's new and which agents the community uses most.
label: AI Chef Pro · 1,000,000
p_hito: This week, AI Chef Pro agents crossed the one million queries solved mark since we launched the platform. One million recipes, cost breakdowns, menus, spec sheets, business plans, and kitchen questions that someone like you solved in minutes instead of hours.
alt_imagen: Professional kitchen brigade in full service, seen from the pass
p_gracias: That million doesn't belong to us — it belongs to the community of chefs, pastry chefs, bakers, managers, and students who show up every day to work with their agents. Thank you for trusting us. And since a number on its own doesn't do much for you in the kitchen, here's what's new.
h_modelos: Which AI model cooks best? Now you can find out
p_modelos: In the Modelos IA + LLM section of the platform you'll find seven next-generation models, each with its own personality, ready for you to throw the same question at all of them and compare their answers:
p_modelos_prueba: Here's a test worth running: ask three of them to rebalance the same autumn menu with a food cost of 30% and see what they come back with. Grok pulls real-time information, Sonar researches with cited sources, and the open-source models fly through long-form text.
